description: Validates a Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 UBL document against the Peppol rules, or a getpeppr invoice JSON against the SDK rules, and explains each violation. It does not check whether the invoice can be sent. Send sample or test invoices only, never a real invoice or real people's data.

format.description: "ubl" for a Peppol BIS 3 UBL document, "json" for a getpeppr SDK invoice.

invoice.description: A sample or test invoice in the getpeppr SDK shape, never a real one, when format is "json".

xml.description: A sample or test UBL document, never a real invoice, when format is "ubl" (at most 1 MiB).

name: validate_invoice
title: Validate an invoice
